Reconstructed saved3/4 plus pet kill, abandonment/reacceptance, no-quest/deferred-abandon/missing-victim cases and group range/life/contact gates pass. Saved-state reconstruction is not a DB login test; packet/world/storage/questgiver access services remain fixtures.

Geometry compiles the existing native DB2/Detour/GridMap/VMap approach helpers using runtime maps, vmaps and mmaps. All20 directed pairs among Havi and the four enemies pass with node budget65535, full untruncated corridor and endpoint, ground/water only and explicit static endpoint LOS. Physical source/target surface checks are applied; this is a player walk/swim survey, not a flying shortcut or magma/slime admission. Endpoint center distances and native diagnostics are recorded below. It does not sweep the complete moving body, dynamic objects, combat chase, swimming depth or rendered client collision along every corner.

No confirmed defect was found, so production quest, combat, spawn, reward and navigation data were preserved. Only tests/audit are committed. The canonical executables/configuration/data were not replaced; no new Release build, server restart, gameplay or new startup verification is claimed for this audit.
